items: R3-PLAN.md#1.4.341, vk/check.sh#VK_DRIVER_FILES — guest system loader + vulkaninfo built for aarch64, run on both phones; the offline gate uses the same loader with VK_DRIVER_FILES

vk/build.sh#library_path, vk/package/README.md#absolute `library_path` — absolute library_path; found via VK_DRIVER_FILES/VK_ICD_FILENAMES, in the guest via the app (BL_VK_DRIVER + the imported icd.json)
ICD manifest/.so replacement under a live process (atomic swap)

nothing in the tree renames a new manifest or .so into place atomically; every run copies before the session starts. Overwriting a mapped ICD is untested and would fault clients that already dlopen'd it
R3-PLAN.md#libc++ static, R3-PLAN.md#qdirect `t_icd` — bionic .so NEEDED: libm libz liblog libdl libc; direct dlopen reports G615/G925 on both phones
R3-PLAN.md#libstdc++, R3-PLAN.md#1.4.341 — glibc .so NEEDED: libdrm libz libzstd libstdc++ libm libc; guest vulkaninfo through the system loader on both phones

the a64-glibc package is stamped with the highest GLIBC_ symbol it needs (2.38). The guest image's own glibc version is not recorded anywhere in this tree, so running it on an older rootfs is untested
libdrm / DRM node (/dev/mali0 is a kbase misc chardev)

drmGetDevice2 rejects the misc char node, so EGL/GBM and zink's kopper have no render node to open: gamescope logs 'Failed to get DRM FD from renderer' and GL falls back to drisw/software. An alias renderD<N> with mali0's rdev (renderD113/renderD288) fixes only the st_rdev match, not drmGetDevice2

bench/RESULTS.md#wayland (120 Hz cap), vk/tests/t_vk_present.c — presented rows run in the guest through Wayland/gamescope with the ICD loaded via --icd; the guest rootfs must provide libwayland-client.so.0 (vk/package/README.md)
vk/STEAM-GAPS.md#t_vk_xcb — phone run, MALI_WSI=sw --pixels PASS: 4 images 1638x720, 3 frames, window pixel BGR 204,102,51. In sw mode wsi_common_wayland binds wl_shm and never reads drm_info

only LINEAR is advertised, so tiled (AFBC) and NV12 client buffers cannot be imported: gamescope asks for NV12 modifiers, gets zero and copies or drops the buffer, which is the extra compositor cost per frame

vk/STEAM-GAPS.md#Round 2 result — scope: host headless gamescope 3.17.0 creates a device on our ICD and all ten composite shaders compile; the guest selects the device. Not a completed guest frame (see CEF row)
Steam X11 client through the gamescope WSI layer (VK_KHR_xcb_surface)
vk/STEAM-GAPS.md#t_vk_xcb, vk/STEAM-GAPS.md#x11 wsi host — xcb swapchain create/acquire/clear/present x3, host and phone; phone --pixels PASS
X11 present without the gamescope layer (needs DRI3)

with no DRI3 there is no pixmap-from-dma-buf, so an unwrapped X11 client cannot present from our linear export: CEF logs 'dri3 extension not supported', gets no GPU memory buffer and its one-copy raster fails. One later probe saw DRI3 on Xwayland :0/:1, so it is session-dependent

the GPU process exits on a lost context (8704 = 34<<8) after our vkCreateDevice succeeds, then the helper calls through NULL in libGLX_mesa: CEF never composites, so the Steam UI has no frame and the session stays in STARTING_STEAM

the client maps our ICD and one shimmed run reached READY, but no session has produced a Steam UI frame: the CEF GPU process is the blocker above, so the runtime loads the driver and the UI does not run on it
vk/STEAM-GAPS.md#glx: failed to create drisw screen, vk/STEAM-GAPS.md#pc=0x0
zink gets no GL screen (silent in release Mesa) and the web helper dies in libGLX_mesa; GLES stays at 2.0 because transform feedback and vertex divisor are missing
vk/deqp/shell-deqp.py#libvulkan.so.1, vk/DEVICE-poco-x4.md#302 Pass — 20-line shim forwards vkGetInstanceProcAddr to the ICD, no guest install; daily sample 302 pass on poco-x4
vk/build.sh#libvulkan_wsi.a, vk/STEAM-GAPS.md#wsi_common — linked statically; wayland/xcb/xlib platforms come from Mesa's wsi_common, and the 'x11 wsi host' gate case exercises the xcb swapchain
